roboplan_decision_record.rationale: Adopt the current upstream release before I6 so one focused adapter is restored and qualified once against the long-lived baseline. Four small upstream-ready dependency-internal fixes preserve correctness and bounds; historical authority and integration patches move to ManyForge boundaries; exact source closure, compatibility, containment, sanitizer, packaging, and performance evidence shows no safety, reliability, or supportability blocker.
accepted_tradeoffs: The exact E1 UR5 joint-RRT fixture is about 12-13% slower, roughly 1.4-1.8 ms, while remaining inside its fixed absolute bounds; Cartesian planning is about 56% faster and other measured workloads, memory, cancellation, replacement, and recovery are comparable or better.

Retiring patch 0007 accepts 6.6% more allocation calls and 17.6% more allocated bytes on its isolated fixture because the measured runtime benefit is negligible and RoboPlan 0.6 exposes no safe reusable-scratch hook; I6 retains ordinary end-to-end allocation and performance gates.
